create_ImageFolder_dataset: create an ImageFolder dataset from a directory of images with optional transforms
build_make_dataset: build a sorted list of image paths from a directory recursively up to a max size
test_is_image_file: test whether a given filename ends with a supported image extension like jpg or png
refactor_default_loader: refactor the default_loader function to open an image path and convert it to RGB
summarize_ImageFolder_getitem: summarize the ImageFolder __getitem__ method that loads and optionally transforms an image by index
